text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest merged PR first. It’s the fastest way to validate its feedback quality without risking live PRs. The trade-off is delayed feedback on the newest open PR, but merged PRs carry proven context, reducing false positives. Shadow mode lets us tune PR-Agent’s rules before full deployment.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on merged PRs won’t catch the edge cases that break open PRs—merged code is already proven, so PR-Agent’s noise only shows up in active reviews. Run it on the newest open PR instead; the risk of false positives is real, but we can mitigate it by tightening the rules first. Settle this by testing PR-Agent on one open PR for a week, then comparing its feedback to human reviews.

name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on both the newest merged PR *and* the newest open PR simultaneously—this doubles the data for tuning rules without adding delay. Tighten the rules on merged PRs first, then apply the refined rules to open PRs to cut false positives faster.
